instance.basis: FICTIONAL. Following a confirmed sabotage incident at a regional utility site, a claim of responsibility appears on an extremist channel. Platform-provenance analysis (high credibility) ties the posting account to the same infrastructure used in pre-incident reconnaissance chatter, making the claimant assessed as the actual actor rather than an opportunist. The claim names a second, specific substation as 'next' and the posting cadence is compressing. The type-low trace-layer indicator conditions upward: a credible actor with demonstrated means declaring a resolved next target is a monitoring-to-active-case transition.
